name: Flameguard Breaker
flavor_text: A veteran warrior who specializes in demolishing ancient barriers and structures. Their mastery of flame-enhanced weaponry makes them invaluable for clearing blocked passages in the ruins.

abilities.name: Inferno Smash
abilities.description: Channel fire through your weapon to shatter walls, doors, and obstacles with devastating force.

abilities.name: Scorching Presence
abilities.description: Your fiery aura and battle-scarred appearance strikes fear into the hearts of enemies.

abilities.name: Flame Strike
abilities.description: Deliver a crushing blow wreathed in flames that burns through armor and flesh alike.

abilities.name: Battle Cry
abilities.description: Rally your allies with a thunderous war shout that inspires courage and determination.
